- 格差=女/男×100、対前年増減率（令和2年は注の※令和元年（新方式）を前年とする）、格差の対前年差、版間（令和6年版と令和7年版の同じ年）、形式間（概況 PDF の行に Excel の値が並ぶか）。式 285、不一致 0。
9c3e1f04802094dda89334ec46ea1ce6ea2d75c2.en:
## c3201 Table 1 (trends in wages by sex, rate of change and gender gap)
- Gap = female/male × 100; year-on-year rate of change (for 2020, the ※2019 (new method) in the note is taken as the previous year); year-on-year difference in the gap; between editions (the same year in the 2024 edition (Reiwa 6) and the 2025 edition (Reiwa 7)); between formats (whether the Excel values appear in the rows of the overview PDF). 285 formulas, 0 mismatches.
